subject: FU-3: Gate parity — mirror .js last-resort apply_patch field scan into orch-gate.sh (LOW)
description: CDX-1 judge non-blocking follow-up. hooks/orch-gate.js has a last-resort scan over ALL string tool_input fields to extract apply_patch target paths; hooks/orch-gate.sh's jq fallback only checks the known carrier set {input, patch, patch_text, diff, content, text, changes}. For an exotic/novel Codex apply_patch carrier field outside that set, the .js core extracts+denies (more defensive) while the .sh core would extract nothing and could ALLOW an out-of-worktree write on the POSIX track (Codex/Cursor/CI). Mirror the last-resort "scan every string field for patch markers" behavior into orch-gate.sh so the two cores stay at parity. Extend test/apply-patch-confinement.test.js to cover a novel carrier field on the .sh path. Files: hooks/orch-gate.sh, test/apply-patch-confinement.test.js. Severity: LOW — defensive hardening; only bites if a future Codex build introduces a new patch-carrier field.
